observations: Export uses entityData, memoData, domainData, createdAt, creatorName, creatorThumb.
Upload Snapshot normalizes entity position/name/pName/keys/fields/color, remaps entity IDs and rebinds relationships.
Only identifying FK columns belong in keys.fks; ordinary FKs remain in fields.
Relationship types ZERO_OR_ONE and ZERO_OR_MANY are official enum values.
Entity color must be an exact palette key; arbitrary CSS colors fail after entities have already been persisted.
Import skips entities with existing pName. Updated definitions must be imported into a new blank diagram.

validation.officialImportNormalizer: verified locally using the official handler and color palette; no live upload of the foundation schema
